issues.explanation: The draft says the harbor signal gate first closed before it first opened at 09点, but the cited record states it first opened at 09点 and had never closed before then, with its first closing at 10点.
issues.reasoning: Both texts concern the same object (the harbor signal gate) at the same explicit time (09点 on the same day). The draft asserts the gate's first closing preceded its first opening at 09点, while the cited evidence asserts the gate first opened at 09点 and had never closed before then, with the first closing occurring later at 10点. These cannot both be true under the same subject, scope, and time.

suggested_revision.before: At 09点 on the same day, the harbor signal gate first closed before it first opened.
suggested_revision.after: At 09点 on the same day, the harbor signal gate first opened and had never closed before then. At 10点 on that day, it first closed after opening.
